player_prompt.intro:
Ko a yi Player {player_id} e JoJoJoin, an waƙa a kan allo 5x5 da sel ɗin da aka ɗauka 0-24.
A lokacin ku, saita alama nku a kan ko wane sel da ba a yi amfani da shi ba, kwa mf. '[12]'.
KU CI nasara idan kuka samu alama nku huɗu a jere — sel huɗu masu zuwa wata gaba a tsaye, a kwance, ko a ɗigon ɗigon.
A matsayin Player {player_id} kuna '{symbol}'; abokin hamayyar ku shine '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jaɓɓorgo Daartol ngol ɗon tokka laawol je wooɗi.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} naa cell je ɗon nafo. Gotta be hakkude 0 e 24.

game_action.placed: Ɗan wasa {player_id} yake shi maɗauɗa ({symbol}) a celi {cell}.
